description: This file defines the MenuItem entity class for the OrangeHRM project, using Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping. It includes properties such as id, menuTitle, parent, level, orderHint, status, screen, and additionalParams, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Represents a menu item entity with hierarchical and screen linkage properties, used within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the menu item.

methods.name: getMenuTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the menu.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent MenuItem if exists.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of the menu item in hierarchy.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the level of the menu item.

methods.name: getOrderHint
methods.description: Returns the order hint for display.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns associated Screen entity if any.

methods.name: getAdditionalParams
methods.description: Returns additional parameters as an array.
